summary: Surveyed python/rust/web/nix/lean extension manifests and the loader/routing/hook source code to establish the real extension file contract, and built a current (2026) TypeScript toolchain detection matrix verified against live web search (TS7 GA, ESLint v10, Bun text lockfile default, Vite 8/Rolldown).

artifacts.summary: Real extension file contract (loader-enforced vs convention-only), manifest/index-entries.json field-to-consumer table, lifecycle-hook and observer execution contracts, keyword_overrides/hard_contracts resolution mechanics, and the 2026 TypeScript toolchain detection matrix (runtimes, package managers, test runners, typecheck/build, lint/format, module resolution).

memory_candidates.content: The extension loader (lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/manifest.lua) only hard-requires manifest.json's name/version/description to be non-empty strings; EXTENSION.md, README.md, and index-entries.json are convention-only, enforced solely by check-extension-docs.sh's lint (never the loader). provides and merge_targets are shape-validated if present but are themselves optional at the loader-validation layer, even though the dev guide marks merge_targets 'Yes'.

keyword_overrides (consumed at /task creation time by task-type-detect.sh step 4b, whole-word first-match-wins, alphabetical directory scan order matters) and hard_contracts (consumed once per --hard dispatch via routing_lookup_flat(), a one-level {task_type:[...]} map unrelated to agent routing) are two independently-resolved, differently-shaped manifest blocks despite superficial similarity. Only two extensions (lean, cslib) declare hard_contracts; declaring none (books) is a valid documented default.

As of mid-2026: TypeScript 7.0 (Go-native tsgo compiler) reached GA in July 2026, so tsc itself is now the fast native binary for any typescript@7.x project (no separate tsgo detection needed, version-gate instead). ESLint v10 (Feb 2026) removed .eslintrc* support entirely. Bun's text bun.lock is the default lockfile since Bun 1.2 (binary bun.lockb is legacy). Vite 8 (stable March 2026) made Rolldown the default production bundler, replacing esbuild+Rollup.
